items.markdown:
The main differences between red and green Thai curry are their chili types, color, and flavor profiles: `red uses dried red chilis for an earthy, deep heat, while green uses fresh green chilis and extra herbs for a bright, herbal spice`.[](https://www.orientalmart.co.uk/blog/difference-between-thai-curry) [[1]](https://www.orientalmart.co.uk/blog/difference-between-thai-curry)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/chefnikkyofficial/videos/%EF%B8%8F-green-curry-vs-red-curry-whats-the-differencegreen-curry-is-the-spiciest-it-ge/638076406021869/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DTt9_EFkfsT/?hl=en)

Red Thai Curry

- **Chilis:** Made with mature dried red chili peppers.
- **Flavor:** Warmer, deeper, and slightly smoky or savory.
- **Appearance:** Rich reddish hue.[](https://thethai.uk/uncategorized/a-guide-to-thai-curries/) [[1]](https://thethai.uk/uncategorized/a-guide-to-thai-curries/)[[2]](https://www.sabaisabai.com/curry-compass-red-vs-green-vs-panang/)

Green Thai Curry

- **Chilis & Herbs:** Made with fresh young green chilis, extra Thai basil, and coriander (cilantro) roots.
- **Flavor:** Fresher, sweeter, and punchy with herbal notes.
- **Appearance:** Vibrant light green hue.[](https://www.cottagedelight.co.uk/blog/whats-the-difference-between-red-and-green-thai-curry/) [[1]](https://www.cottagedelight.co.uk/blog/whats-the-difference-between-red-and-green-thai-curry/)
